europe_now.title: Romania shuts only nuclear plant as heat causes huge drop in Danube River level
europe_now.summary: Romania has shut down its sole nuclear power plant due to a significant drop in the Danube River level caused by extreme heat, raising concerns about energy supply across the region. The drought conditions are affecting multiple European countries, with Hungary also reporting critically low water levels impacting navigation and power generation.

sources.headline: Romania shuts only nuclear plant as heat causes huge drop in Danube River level

europe_now.title: Poland detains Russian seeking to assassinate US-Ukrainian citizen in Warsaw
europe_now.summary: Polish authorities have detained a Russian national suspected of planning to assassinate a US-Ukrainian citizen in Warsaw, highlighting ongoing security threats linked to the Ukraine conflict. The incident underscores rising tensions and potential spillover risks from the war in neighboring countries.

sources.headline: Poland detains Russian seeking to assassinate US-Ukrainian citizen in Warsaw

top_stories.title: European drought and heatwave disrupt energy and agriculture sectors
top_stories.summary: Severe drought conditions across Europe have forced Romania to shut its only nuclear plant and are severely impacting crop yields, with France estimating heatwave-related costs between €10 billion and €15 billion. The environmental crisis is straining infrastructure and economies from the Danube region to southwestern France.

sources.headline: Romania shuts only nuclear plant as heat causes huge drop in Danube River level

top_stories.title: Ukraine conflict escalates with cross-border strikes and rising civilian casualties
top_stories.summary: Cross-border attacks and intensified fighting have pushed civilian casualties in Ukraine to their highest levels since 2022, according to recent reports. The deteriorating situation continues to strain regional stability and humanitarian conditions.
